china-1929-30:p0272_2.rationale: Roster of British consular officers by post in China, including consular judges at Shanghai; names and ranks only. It is a diplomatic and consular service list.

china-1929-30:p0276_1.rationale: List of officers administering the British-occupied leased territory of Weihaiwei, with periods and notes on its colonial control. The content is textual.

china-1929-30:p0276_2.rationale: Names and offices of the principal officials of the Kwantung Government in the leased territory. A textual roster of colonial administrators.

china-1929-30:p0284_1.rationale: Anglo-Chinese calendar for 1928 giving weekday, date and Chinese moon day for each day; it is a calendar conversion table.

china-1929-30:p0286_1.rationale: Anglo-Chinese calendar for 1929 giving weekday, date and Chinese moon day for each day; it is a calendar conversion table.

china-1929-30:p0289_1.rationale: Anglo-Chinese calendar for 1930 giving weekday, date and Chinese moon day for each day; it is a calendar conversion table.

china-1929-30:p0291_1.rationale: Inventory of foreign newspapers and English-language journals in China by place, title and frequency. Some entries are periodicals, but newspapers predominate.

china-1929-30:p0295_1.rationale: A list of the principal companies transacting life insurance business in China. It is a textual list of company names.

china-1929-30:p0295_2.rationale: Amounts of life insurance in force in China by company, in different currencies; it is a statistical insurance table.

china-1929-30:p0298_1.rationale: Population of the Kwantung Leased Territory and the South Manchuria Railway Zone in 1928 by sex and nationality (Japanese, Chinese, foreigners), with totals.
